name: Brand {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Identity, voice and the visual system that carries them.

commands.name: /brand
commands.does: Orients: reports system version, coverage and the next decision.
commands.returns: System state, open audit failures and one named next action.

commands.name: /brand-core
commands.does: Establishes the identity core from the claim and the audience register.
commands.returns: Register, archetype, promise and naming conventions, each traced to its source.

commands.name: /brand-name
commands.does: Names a company, product or feature and tests the name.
commands.returns: Candidates with a verdict against claim, category and audience register.

commands.name: /brand-voice
commands.does: Writes voice rules as accept and refuse pairs.
commands.returns: Rules with one sentence accepted and one refused, plus the rules dropped as unfalsifiable.

commands.name: /brand-visual
commands.does: Builds the visual system: type, colour, spacing, imagery, logo usage.
commands.returns: The system with a rationale per decision and the environments it was tested against.

commands.name: /brand-tokens
commands.does: Emits the visual system as machine readable tokens.
commands.returns: Tokens with contrast and size constraints checked, failures with replacements.

commands.name: /brand-audit
commands.does: Audits one artifact rule by rule against the system.
commands.returns: Pass or fail per rule with the offending sentence, value or crop cited.

commands.name: /brand-asset
commands.does: Registers an asset with usage rules, or prepares a third party release.
commands.returns: A library entry with allowed and forbidden surfaces, or a release pending approval.

commands.name: /brand-system
commands.does: Renders identity, naming, voice and visual system as one versioned artifact.
commands.returns: The system document with version, date and diff since the previous version.

commands.name: /brand-evolve
commands.does: Versions a change and produces the migration list of affected surfaces.
commands.returns: The version diff, the migration list and the surfaces blocking closure.

commands.name: /brand-handoff
commands.does: Packages the system subset one downstream unit consumes.
commands.returns: The unit specific package and what that unit may extend versus not reinterpret.

commands.name: /brand-review
commands.does: Audits a sample of live surfaces and reports drift.
commands.returns: Drift by surface, the rules most often broken and candidate rule changes.

requires_human_approval_for: any rebrand, or any change to the identity core
any name change of the company, a product or a feature
releasing brand assets to a third party, agency, partner or affiliate
publishing anything under the identity, on any surface
shipping an artifact that failed audit, with a named approver and reason
retiring or replacing a token that live surfaces already consume
